notes:
I inspected the sample app files (app/db.py, app/main.py) and the included scripts; the app already implements several documented best practices (singleton MongoClient, env reading, compound index creation on startup, use of UpdateOne upsert with unordered bulk_write and batching). Public Microsoft documentation (learn.microsoft.com) provides guidance for TLS, connection-string options (mongodb+srv, retryWrites=false, maxIdleTimeMS), Private Link, Entra ID/RBAC, index types including background builds and TTL semantics, bulk-write optimization (ordered=false and recommended ~1000 per-process batches), and the integrated vector-search features (DiskANN/HNSW/IVF) and their tuning parameters. Where explicit Azure DocumentDB public guidance did not appear (for a few prior beliefs such as composing deterministic _id for idempotency, detailed pool-sizing heuristics, or explicit API-level pagination recommendations), I recorded those prior beliefs as prior_knowledge_only and listed the searches I ran in how_found for those entries.
